mapper.select: SELECT act03_journal_dtl_id AS journal_dtl_id, act03_dr_account_cd AS dr_account_code, f_get_account_nm(act02_company_id, act03_dr_account_cd) AS dr_account_name, act03_dr_amt AS dr_amt, f_ast_class_tree_nm(act03_dr_ast_id) AS dr_ast_name, act03_cr_account_cd AS cr_account_code, f_get_account_nm(act02_company_id, act03_cr_account_cd) AS cr_account_name, act03_cr_amt AS cr_amt, f_ast_class_tree_nm(act03_cr_ast_id) AS cr_ast_name FROM act02_journal INNER JOIN act03_journal_dtl ON act03_journal_id = act02_journal_id WHERE act02_company_id = #{companyId} AND act02_date = #{payDate} AND act02_pay_month_cd = #{payType} ORDER BY act03_seq
